summary: Kamada Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, attaching a press release announcing it will report third quarter and nine-month 2026 financial results before the U.S. market open on Monday, November 9, 2026, with a conference call at 8:30am ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The sole ownership datum is FIMI Opportunity Funds' existing approximately 38% beneficial holding as controlling shareholder. What to watch: quarterly results and call commentary, not a special situation event.
